faqs.question: Is Eclipse Prayer for solar and lunar eclipses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Solar eclipse prayer is often called Salat al-Kusuf, and lunar eclipse prayer is often called Salat al-Khusuf.

faqs.question: Does Eclipse Prayer have an adhan or iqamah?
faqs.answer: Eclipse Prayer is commonly performed without the regular adhan or iqamah. Communities may call people together with a simple announcement.

faqs.question: How many rak'ahs are in Eclipse Prayer?
faqs.answer: In many Sunni communities, Eclipse Prayer is two rak'ahs with extra standing and bowing in each rak'ah. Follow your imam or local scholarly guidance.

hero.titleHtml: Eclipse Prayer: solar and lunar salah.
hero.introductionHtml: Eclipse Prayer is the salah Muslims offer during a solar or lunar eclipse, turning a striking sign in creation into prayer, remembrance, supplication, and charity.
hero.summaryHtml:
• When: during a solar or lunar eclipse until it clears.
  • Names: Kusuf is often used for solar eclipse, Khusuf for lunar eclipse.
  • Common form: two rak'ahs with extra standing and bowing.
  • Note: details differ by madhhab, so follow your imam or local scholars.
